settings.heading: Choose your study partner.
settings.subheading: Start with API status and per-task default models (editable inline), then add a custom gateway or local model. Model capabilities, cost estimates and semantic search live below.
settings.taskHint.explain: Explanations use the primary model; picking a verification model enables accurate mode (both models answer independently).
settings.taskHint.grade: Subjective grading always cross-verifies: it reuses the explanation model by default; you can pick a separate verification model on the right. The judge model only locates disagreements.
settings.taskHint.judge: With three-model cross-verification, model C (independent judge) locates the diverging steps; the primary model can't judge itself. If unset, verification model B decides.
settings.taskHint.notes: Knowledge notes use the primary model; in accurate mode the verification model re-checks citations and conclusions. Outline pausing and chunk extraction are independent of model slots.
settings.taskHint.ocr: Scan OCR needs a vision model; the page prefers its own selector and falls back to this default.
settings.taskHint.upload: Photo recognition and solving need a vision model; the page can override both primary and verification models.
settings.taskHint.tagging: Batch tagging uses the primary model; results are only candidate labels until an admin verifies them.
settings.taskHint.course: AI classroom outline/scene generation uses the primary model; accurate mode re-checks scene structure with the verification model. The judge model isn't used for classroom generation.
settings.taskHint.paper-import: Paper recognition needs a vision model; results become drafts for human review. Verification/judge models aren't used for recognition.
settings.taskHint.paper-enrich: AI completion of answers/explanations/knowledge points uses the primary model; the verification model can cross-check, and human-verified questions are never overwritten.
settings.taskHint.paper-compose: AI composition lets the primary model pick from real candidates; hard checks on counts/types/difficulty/knowledge quotas are independent of the verification model.
settings.taskHint.paper-revision: AI consolidation papers let the primary model pick questions with a reason each; insufficient candidates fail explicitly. Verification/judge models don't pick questions.
settings.taskHint.insight-report: Learning-report suggestions use the primary model based only on real page statistics; verification/judge models aren't used.
settings.taskHint.assistant-turn: A single AI-assistant turn uses the primary model; tool calls run through the server-side allowlist without verification/judge models.
